title.en: Refraction at spherical surfaces and lenses

hook.en: An optician grinds glass to a chosen curvature and gives you exactly +2 dioptres. How does the shape of the glass decide its power?
hook.kn: ದೃಗ್ವಿಜ್ಞಾನಿ ಗಾಜನ್ನು ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ವಕ್ರತೆಗೆ ಉಜ್ಜಿ ನಿಖರವಾಗಿ +2 ಡಯಾಪ್ಟರ್ ಕನ್ನಡಕ ಕೊಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಗಾಜಿನ ಆಕಾರ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯವನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ?

objectives.en: Use refraction at a single spherical surface
Derive and apply the lens maker's formula
Use the thin lens formula, power and combinations

narration.en: An optician grinds glass to a chosen curvature and gives you exactly +2 dioptres. How does the shape of the glass decide its power?
narration.kn: ದೃಗ್ವಿಜ್ಞಾನಿ ಗಾಜನ್ನು ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ವಕ್ರತೆಗೆ ಉಜ್ಜಿ ನಿಖರವಾಗಿ +2 ಡಯಾಪ್ಟರ್ ಕನ್ನಡಕ ಕೊಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಗಾಜಿನ ಆಕಾರ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯವನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ?

body.en: For a spherical surface of radius $R$ separating media $n_1$ (object side) and $n_2$, the object and image distances satisfy $n_2/v - n_1/u = (n_2 - n_1)/R$. Applying it to both surfaces of a thin lens gives the lens maker's formula $1/f = (n_{21} - 1)(1/R_1 - 1/R_2)$.
body.kn: ಗೋಳೀಯ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಯಲ್ಲಿ n₂/v − n₁/u = (n₂ − n₁)/R. ಎರಡೂ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಗಳಿಗೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಿದರೆ ಮಸೂರ ತಯಾರಕರ ಸೂತ್ರ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: In a denser liquid a lens's power falls

narration.en: For a spherical surface of radius R separating media n_1 (object side) and n_2, the object and image distances satisfy n_2/v - n_1/u = (n_2 - n_1)/R. Applying it to both surfaces of a thin lens gives the lens maker's formula 1/f = (n_{21} - 1)(1/R_1 - 1/R_2).
narration.kn: ಗೋಳೀಯ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಯಲ್ಲಿ n₂/v − n₁/u = (n₂ − n₁)/R. ಎರಡೂ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಗಳಿಗೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಿದರೆ ಮಸೂರ ತಯಾರಕರ ಸೂತ್ರ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: Thin lens formula, power and combinations

body.en: For a thin lens $1/v - 1/u = 1/f$ and $m = v/u$. Power $P = 1/f$, in dioptres when $f$ is in metres; convex lenses have positive power. Thin lenses in contact add their powers: $P = P_1 + P_2 + \dots$, and the total magnification is the product of the individual magnifications.
body.kn: ತೆಳು ಮಸೂರ ಸೂತ್ರ 1/v − 1/u = 1/f, m = v/u. ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ P = 1/f (ಡಯಾಪ್ಟರ್). ಸಂಪರ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಮಸೂರಗಳ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯಗಳು ಕೂಡುತ್ತವೆ.

points.en: P = P₁ + P₂ for lenses in contact

narration.en: For a thin lens 1/v - 1/u = 1/f and m = v/u. Power P = 1/f, in dioptres when f is in metres; convex lenses have positive power. Thin lenses in contact add their powers: P = P_1 + P_2 + \dots, and the total magnification is the product of the individual magnifications.
narration.kn: ತೆಳು ಮಸೂರ ಸೂತ್ರ 1/v − 1/u = 1/f, m = v/u. ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ P = 1/f (ಡಯಾಪ್ಟರ್). ಸಂಪರ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಮಸೂರಗಳ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯಗಳು ಕೂಡುತ್ತವೆ.

caption.en: PhET Geometric Optics: a lens with an object and its image. Change the radius of curvature, refractive index and the object's position.

tryThis.en: Make the lens more curved: the focal length shortens.
Lower the refractive index: the focal length grows.
Move the object inside F: the image turns virtual.

narration.en: PhET Geometric Optics: a lens with an object and its image. Change the radius of curvature, refractive index and the object's position. Make the lens more curved: the focal length shortens. Lower the refractive index: the focal length grows. Move the object inside F: the image turns virtual.

aim.en: To find the focal length of a convex lens by plotting graphs between u and v and between 1/u and 1/v.

narration.en: At the virtual bench we find the image for several object distances and plot 1/v against 1/u; the intercepts give 1/f.

problem.en: An object is 30 cm in front of a convex lens of focal length 10 cm. Find the image position and magnification.

answer.en: 15 cm on the other side; real, inverted, half size

narration.en: Let us solve this together. An object is 30 cm in front of a convex lens of focal length 10 cm. Find the image position and magnification.

problem.en: A biconvex lens (n = 1.5) has R₁ = 10 cm and R₂ = −15 cm. Find its focal length and power.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A biconvex lens (n = 1.5) has R₁ = 10 cm and R₂ = −15 cm. Find its focal length and power.

body.en: For lenses in contact, convert each focal length to dioptres (100/f in cm), add with signs, then convert back. Never add focal lengths directly.

narration.en: Add powers, not focal lengths. For lenses in contact, convert each focal length to dioptres (100/f in cm), add with signs, then convert back. Never add focal lengths directly.

narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two competitive-exam pattern questions. Try them before we discuss.

points.en: n₂/v − n₁/u = (n₂ − n₁)/R at a single surface.
Powers of lenses in contact add.

narration.en: Recap. n₂/v − n₁/u = (n₂ − n₁)/R at a single surface. Lens maker: 1/f = (n − 1)(1/R₁ − 1/R₂). 1/v − 1/u = 1/f; m = v/u; P = 1/f. Powers of lenses in contact add.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಒಂದು ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಗೆ n₂/v − n₁/u = (n₂ − n₁)/R. ಮಸೂರ ತಯಾರಕರ ಸೂತ್ರ: 1/f = (n − 1)(1/R₁ − 1/R₂). 1/v − 1/u = 1/f; m = v/u; P = 1/f. ಸಂಪರ್ಕದ ಮಸೂರಗಳ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯಗಳು ಕೂಡುತ್ತವೆ.
